long_biography.plain_text:
At ProTec Laboratory, Sail Ricks helped build an East Texas plant for brands that needed product development as well as production. The factory developed and filled powders, liquids, tablets, capsules and softgels. Its customers spanned sports nutrition, functional foods and pet-care products, so the business worked across multiple formulations rather than selling a single consumer line.

Rosewood Private Investments bought a majority interest in the company. The investor's capital gave the founders scope to expand capacity and automate more production. Beyond manufacturing, Ricks competed for years in offshore billfish tournaments. He and a Texas-based team won the Emerald Bay Championship in the Bahamas, and his catches also featured in Bermuda events.
